sections.label: 🚀 Feature
items: discogs.com, the MusicBrainz column (with murdos' importer): a Discogs release that no MusicBrainz release links yet can now be looked for by its barcode, as majkinetor's First Contact does. 🔎 beside ▶ MB counts such releases; a press asks Discogs for each one's barcode, formats and tracks and searches MusicBrainz by the barcode, and a MusicBrainz release whose barcode, kind of media and track count agree shows as a candidate: the release icon in a dashed box with ≈ (≈2 for two). It is not a link: its card says what agreed, a click opens the release on MusicBrainz, and ⧉ copies the Discogs address to add it there yourself. At most 25 releases a press (60 with a Discogs token), never automatic, each answer kept for 7 days; 📊 "» MB links: candidate" keeps only the candidates.

sections.label: 🚀 Feature
items: New ⚠️ finding "The same page linked twice in Relationships": the Relationships column now knows when two links are one page in different forms (Apple Music's /us/ and /gb/ storefront of one album, a Discogs release with and without its title in the address, tidal.com and listen.tidal.com, a Qobuz page in two locales, Deezer, Spotify and Beatport likewise), as majkinetor's scripts do. Such a link is a duplicate to remove. "Several links to one site in Relationships" now counts only really different pages, so those forms no longer show up there, and amazon.de and amazon.com stay different stores. Both findings have their own switch and highlight in ⚙️ Settings, and the tooltip names every form.
